battle.name: 六合之戰
battle.brief: 開禧二年（1206）十一月，金朝左副元帥僕散揆統九路大軍南下，宋將畢再遇退守江防要塞六合。金軍逼近城壕，宋軍弓弩齊發、旗鼓並舉，伏兵突出而大破金軍；完顏蒲剌都率十萬騎兵圍城，焚柵決水皆為勁弩所退。弩在城頭撐住全場，又以舉青蓋誘射，斂回二萬餘支箭矢。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 六合之戰是開禧二年（一二〇六）十月至十一月，南宋與金朝在江淮地區的一場攻防戰。金一方以左副元帥僕散揆為統帥，分兵九路自河北、山東、河南並進，主力自八迭浦渡過淮河；節制江淮兩翼的大將有完顏蒲剌都、紇石烈子仁等，完顏蒲剌都一路領騎兵十萬。金朝兵制以猛安謀克為骨幹，女真、契丹將領分統各部，騎兵為進攻主力，步兵與匠役隨之攻城，糧秣則靠淮河與運河上的船隻北運。宋一方是南宋的江淮防線：寧宗開禧二年，樞密院韓侂冄執掌軍政，一意主戰，江淮沿邊分置楚州、滁州、濠州、六合等處鎮戍，此次守六合的是鎮江副都統制畢再遇所部，兵不多而以步卒與弓弩手為主，糧餉由建康及楚州接濟。開禧北伐同時，南宋四川安撫使吳曦已舉兵叛宋降金，前線與後方同時生變，使這場戰爭從一開始就夾在北伐與平叛的雙重壓力之間。
countriesEn: The Battle of Liuhe was a defensive engagement fought between the Southern Song and the Jin dynasty on the Huai and middle Yangtze front between the tenth and eleventh months of the second year of Kaixi (1206), the sixth year of Taihe under the Jin emperor Zhangzong. On the Jin side the field command belonged to the Left Deputy Marshal Pusan Kui, who led nine columns advancing in parallel out of Hebei, Shandong and Henan, with the main body fording the Huai river at Badiepu; the commanders holding the Jianghuai flanks included Wanyan Puladu and Hetilie Ziren, and Wanyan Puladu brought up a force of one hundred thousand cavalry. Jin military organisation rested on the meng'an mouke, with Jurchen and Khitan officers commanding the several columns; cavalry was the arm of the assault, infantry and artisans followed them up for the siege work, and grain was moved north on the river craft of the Huai and of the canals. On the Song side stood the Southern Song's Huai and Yangtze defence line: in the second year of Kaixi the Privy Council was in the hands of Han Tuozhou, who was set on war, and the river was held by a chain of garrisons at Chuzhou in modern Huai'an, at Chuzhou in modern Anhui, at Haozhou and at Liuhe. The force that held Liuhe on this occasion was a detachment under Bi Zaiyu, the deputy commander of the Zhenjiang circuit: not numerous, composed mainly of foot and of crossbowmen, with grain and pay brought up from Jiankang and from Chuzhou. The Kaixi northern campaign was also the moment when Wu Xi, the Pacification Commissioner of Sichuan, rose in revolt against the Song and surrendered to the Jin, so that front and rear were both in movement at once and this war was from the outset caught between the pressure of the offensive and the pressure of the suppression.
people: 留下姓名的多屬金方。僕散揆，契丹人，金朝左副元帥，開禧北伐的主帥，十月統九路大軍南下，是這場戰爭的策動者與最高指揮。完顏蒲剌都，金宗室將領，率騎兵十萬追到六合北面的成家橋與馬鞍山，企圖以兵力壓垮孤城，攻城不克而退。紇石烈子仁為金朝另一名大將，與蒲剌都會師之後集兵攻城，與畢再遇在城下的攻守最為膠著。宋方最關鍵的人物是畢再遇：早年流落江淮，後投軍效命南宋，積功至鎮江副都統制，此次率兵一部退守江防要塞六合，在金軍鐵騎到來之前先取守勢，又以弓弩、伏兵與誘敵之計連番挫其銳氣，孤軍當十萬之眾而城不拔，成為南渡之後以守城戰成名的一段佳話。決策層面上，樞密院韓侂冄在宋寧宗支持下推行北伐，一意催促諸路進兵，卻因用兵倉促、準備不足而授人以柄，最終開禧三年（一二〇七）為部下所殺；金方的金章宗則坐鎮燕京，遙控南線。另可一提四川安撫使吳曦，開禧二年在成都以蜀王之名叛宋降金，其事與此戰同時發生，也牽動了整條淮西的局勢。
peopleEn: Most of the names that survive belong to the Jin side. Pusan Kui, a Khitan, was the Left Deputy Marshal of the Jin and the commander of the Kaixi northern campaign; in the tenth month he led nine columns south and was both the author of the war and its highest authority on the field. Wanyan Puladu, a general of the imperial clan, brought up one hundred thousand cavalry as far as Chengjiaqiao and Ma'anshan north of Liuhe, hoping to crush a lone city by weight of numbers, and withdrew when the siege made no progress. Hetilie Ziren was another of the Jin commanders; after joining with Puladu he massed his troops for the assault, and the contest in the shadow of the walls was the closest and most stubborn of the whole engagement. The decisive figure on the Song side was Bi Zaiyu. He had drifted through the Huai and Yangtze region in his youth, then entered Song service and fought for the Southern Song until he had risen to be deputy commander of the Zhenjiang circuit. On this occasion he took a detachment back to Liuhe, that fortress on the river defence, and against the approach of the Jin cavalry he took up a position of defence first, then broke the enemy spirit again and again with the crossbow, with an ambush and with a ruse, holding the city with a few men against a hundred thousand. At the level of decision, Han Tuozhou of the Privy Council pushed the northern campaign with the support of the Song emperor Ningzong, urging the various columns forward without cease, but the haste of the mobilisation and the lack of preparation gave the enemy his opening, and in the end he was killed by his own men in the third year of Kaixi (1207); on the Jin side the emperor Zhangzong sat at Yanjing and directed the southern lines from afar. Wu Xi, the Pacification Commissioner of Sichuan, is also worth mentioning: in the second year of Kaixi he rose at Chengdu, proclaimed himself Prince of Shu, and handed the Song over to the Jin, a business that ran at the same time as this battle and dragged at the whole of the Huai west.
kits: 卡面上是十字弩，這件兵器在六合城下的位置十分明確。弩把射速交給了機械，裝填慢，不能像長弓那樣連發，但它在城頭有兩項別的兵器沒有的好處：一是單發的力道與精度足以壓制城下進逼的人，二是射手可以伏在城垛之後，縮短被城頭反弓射到的風險。宋軍把弓弩手佈在城下近城壕之處，專候金軍靠近城壕時齊發；完顏蒲剌都圍城之後，又以勁弩回退焚燒木柵、掘決圩水的步卒，說明守城方的主要火力輸出正是弩。金兵自八迭浦渡淮以來，野戰中大量倚賴騎兵配長弓，騎射本是金軍的長技，可到了城下攻堅的場合，騎兵無法展開，只能下馬步戰，攻擊手段退回到火、水、梯三路。弩的弱點同樣在記錄裡看得見：城中箭矢用盡。畢再遇的辦法是派人舉青蓋在城上走動，金軍以為是主將出巡，紛紛爭著發射，宋軍於城下揀回二萬餘支箭，一夜之間補上最要命的缺口。弩兵之外，宋軍還有長弓、標槍與守城用的長柄兵器，堤塹、木柵與城壕構成防線；金軍則依靠馬匹、攻具與隨軍糧車維持十萬騎兵的作戰，糧道沿淮河與運河北上，十一月的雨雪則是宋軍追擊與金軍退卻共同面對的變數。十字弩這個名目來自歐洲的弩機形制，與中國自漢代以來自成一系的弩同出於機括儲力一途；宋代弩兵編制中更有神臂弓、弓弩諸器，量與質都遠勝早期形制。
kitsEn: The card shows a crossbow, and the place of that weapon in the fighting below the walls of Liuhe is quite clear. A crossbow gives up the rate of fire to mechanism: it is slow to load and cannot shoot like a longbow in a sequence of arrows, but on a wall it has two advantages no other missile has. First, the power and precision of a single shot are enough to hold back men coming up to the ditch. Second, the shooter can lie flat behind the parapet, which shortens the time he is exposed to the enemy archers on the walls. The Song posted its crossbowmen down near the ditch inside the walls, waiting for the Jin to come close before firing in unison; after Wanyan Puladu surrounded the city they drove off with heavy crossbows the footmen who were burning the wooden fence and cutting the embankments to let the water in, which shows that the main output of fire from the defenders was the crossbow. Since fording the Huai at Badiepu the Jin had leaned heavily on mounted archers in the open field, for the riding and shooting was the Jin's long suit, but once the work came to a siege below the walls the cavalry had no room to deploy and had to fight on foot, and the means of attack fell back on fire, on water and on ladders. The weakness of the crossbow is just as visible in the record: the city ran out of arrows. Bi Zaiyu's answer was to have men carry a green umbrella about the wall, so that the Jin took it for the commander going his rounds, and they all competed to shoot at it; the Song picked up more than twenty thousand arrows from the foot of the wall and filled the most critical gap in a single night. Alongside the crossbowmen the Song had longbows, javelins and long-handled pole weapons for the defence, with ditches, wooden fences and the moat making up the line. The Jin relied on horses, on siege materials and on baggage wagons to keep one hundred thousand cavalry in action, their supply line running north along the Huai and the canals, and the rain and snow of the eleventh month was a variable that both the Song pursuit and the Jin retreat had to face. The name on the card, the crossbow, comes from the European form with its spanning mechanism; it belongs to the same family of stored-power machines as the crossbow that China had developed on its own line since the Han, and the Song establishment held a whole range of crossbows, among them the divine arm bow, far exceeding the early forms in both quantity and quality.
tactics: 整場戰事可以拆成五步。第一步是金軍長驅：十月，僕散揆自八迭浦渡淮，濠口守將不戰而逃，滁州、濠州相繼失守，兵鋒直抵楚州一線，士氣極盛。第二步是畢再遇轉入守勢：他把兵部退入六合這座江防要塞，偃旗息鼓，不與金軍爭野戰勝負。第三步是竹鎮前哨戰：金軍進至距六合二十五里的竹鎮，畢再遇在南門設伏，於城下佈弓弩手，等金軍逼近城壕之際弓弩齊發、旗鼓並舉，伏兵同時突出，一戰而金軍大敗。第四步是圍城攻擊：完顏蒲剌都率騎兵十萬進駐成家橋、馬鞍山，圍城數重，企圖以火焚木柵、以水決圩，兩次都被宋軍勁弩射退；紇石烈子仁到達後兩軍合兵，攻城更急，而畢再遇依托城垣死守，同時不斷出奇兵擾敵，使金軍不得休息，又屢次派人試探城防薄弱之處。第五步是退兵與追擊：金軍攻無所效，弓弩覆蓋下的攻城將士死傷狼藉，遂引兵而去；畢再遇率追兵直抵滁州，值雨雪之際才收兵回師。十一月的江淮雨雪既是金軍退卻的掩護，也使宋軍的追擊難以展開。
tacticsEn: The course of the fighting can be broken into five stages. The first is the Jin long march: in the tenth month Pusan Kui forded the Huai at Badiepu, the Song commander at Haokou fled without a battle, Chuzhou and Haozhou fell one after another, and the point of the Jin army reached the line of Chuzhou in Huai'an with its morale at its highest. The second is Bi Zaiyu's turn to the defensive. He drew his detachment back into Liuhe, that fortress on the river defence, kept his flags furled and his drums silent, and declined to contest the matter in the open field. The third is the action at Zhuzhen, the forward post. The Jin came on as far as Zhuzhen, twenty-five li from Liuhe; Bi Zaiyu set an ambush at the south gate and posted crossbowmen below the wall, and when the Jin closed on the ditch the crossbows fired in unison, the flags and drums sounded together and the ambush struck out, and the Jin were routed in a single action. The fourth is the siege. Wanyan Puladu brought up one hundred thousand cavalry to Chengjiaqiao and Ma'anshan, closed the city in several rings, and tried first fire against the wooden fence and then water against the embankments; both were driven back by the Song heavy crossbows. When Hetilie Ziren arrived the two forces joined, the assault tightened, and Bi Zaiyu held on behind the wall, at the same time sending out irregular troops to harry the enemy and deny it any rest, and he sent men time and again to test where the defences were thinnest. The fifth is the withdrawal and the pursuit. The siege achieved nothing, the men storming the wall under the covering fire of the crossbows were cut to pieces, and the Jin drew their troops off. Bi Zaiyu pursued them as far as Chuzhou and only broke off and returned when rain and snow came on. The rain and snow over the Huai and the Yangtze in the eleventh month served as a cover for the Jin withdrawal and equally held up the Song pursuit.
data: 可核對的數字有幾組。時間：戰爭起於開禧二年（金章宗泰和六年）十月，金軍渡淮並在淮東接戰在十月，六合城下的決戰在十一月。距離：竹鎮距六合二十五里，約十二點五公里。兵力：完顏蒲剌都所部騎兵十萬，是史籍明載的數字，也是修辭性質的大數。箭矢：宋軍舉青蓋誘敵發射，事後揀得二萬餘支箭矢。編制：金軍九路進攻，由左副元帥僕散揆總節制。地理：六合在今江蘇省南京市六合區，位於長江北岸，與滁州隔滁水相望；城北的成家橋、馬鞍山是金軍騎兵駐地；渡口在八迭浦，失守要塞為濠口，滁州、濠州相繼淪陷，相對峙之地為楚州（今江蘇淮安），南面的楚州一線是宋軍接應的方向。天候：十一月江淮雨雪，泥濘影響騎兵機動與攻城器械運轉。文獻：《續資治通鑑》卷一百五十七記此役最為扼要，宋人為畢再遇立傳、金人為僕散揆立傳，兩家對兵力細節的記載互有詳略之別。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked fall into several groups. Time: the war began in the tenth month of the second year of Kaixi, the sixth year of Taihe under the Jin emperor Zhangzong; the Jin fording of the Huai and the fighting east of the river belong to that tenth month, and the decision below the walls of Liuhe belongs to the eleventh. Distance: Zhuzhen lay twenty-five li from Liuhe, roughly twelve and a half kilometres. Strength: the one hundred thousand cavalry under Wanyan Puladu is a figure plainly set down in the histories, and it is the sort of large number that rhetoric produces. Arrows: after the Song carried a green umbrella about the wall and drew the enemy's shooting, more than twenty thousand arrows were picked up. Command structure: the Jin attacked in nine columns under the overall direction of the Left Deputy Marshal Pusan Kui. Geography: Liuhe lies in what is now the Liuhe district of Nanjing city in Jiangsu province, on the north bank of the Yangtze, across the Chu river from Chuzhou; Chengjiaqiao and Ma'anshan, north of the city, were where the Jin cavalry stood; the crossing was at Badiepu, the fortress that fell was Haokou, Chuzhou and Haozhou were lost in turn, and the place where the two armies stood facing one another was Chuzhou in modern Huai'an, with the line of Chuzhou to the south the direction from which the Song drew its support. Weather: rain and snow over the Huai and the Yangtze in the eleventh month, with the mud hindering the movement of cavalry and the working of siege machinery. Texts: the Xu Xu Zizhi Tongjian in one hundred and fifty-seven juan gives the most compressed account of this campaign; the Song historians wrote a biography of Bi Zaiyu and the Jin historians one of Pusan Kui, and the two records differ in detail over the numbers engaged.
cause: 打起嚟的原因有兩條線絞在一起。金線：隆興和議之後兩朝表面相安，金章宗後期轉為攻勢，主戰派僕散揆等主張南下宋土，與宋廷爭兩淮的產馬與茶利；金朝西北正在用兵，兵力可以抽調到南線，宋線也就成了轉嫁壓力的去處。宋線：開禧二年（一二〇六）韓侂冄執樞密、掌軍政，力主北伐，一再催促沿邊進兵，甚至換下主和派將領，想趁金朝內外交困之際收復兩淮。可是宋軍準備不足、諸將觀望，宋廷又為撥發軍費與調兵之事宜爭論不休；更麻煩的是四川安撫使吳曦已被金朝說動，準備舉兵叛宋。兩條線撞在一起的結果就是：金人搶先在十月全面南下，宋軍沿淮線的佈防尚未完成，濠口一失，戰局便一瀉千里，整場戰爭從宋人計劃中的北伐，變成了宋人倉促應對的守禦。
causeEn: There are two threads of cause twisted together here. The Jin thread: after the peace of Longxing the two courts were outwardly at ease, but the later years of the reign of the Jin emperor Zhangzong turned aggressive, and the war party around Pusan Kui argued for a march into Song territory to contest the horses and the tea of the two Huai regions; with the Jin already fighting in the north-west, troops could be drawn off to the southern front, and the Song line became a convenient place to shift the pressure. The Song thread: in the second year of Kaixi (1206) Han Tuozhou held the Privy Council and the conduct of military affairs, pressed for a northern campaign, and kept urging the frontier columns forward, even replacing commanders of the peace party, in the hope of recovering the two Huai while the Jin were beset from within and without. But the Song army was unprepared, the generals hung back, and the court argued endlessly over the issue of military pay and the movement of troops; worse still, the Pacification Commissioner of Sichuan, Wu Xi, had been worked on by the Jin and was preparing to revolt against the Song. When the two threads collided the result was this: the Jin struck south in full across the tenth month, the Song deployment along the Huai was not yet complete, the loss of Haokou sent the situation collapsing, and the war that had been planned in Song terms as an offensive turned into a defence improvised in haste.
impact: 六合一戰本身規模不大，對戰局的改變有限，但三個層面的影響值得記下。第一是戰術層面：它說明在缺少大型攻城器械的條件下，城防依靠弩與城池本身就能拖住數倍於己的騎兵，而且弩的耗箭弱點可以用陣地欺詐之類的手段暫時掩蓋；此後南宋守城諸州普遍重視城頭弩陣與城壕之設，畢再遇憑此役聲名益盛，累升要職，成為南宋後期抗金名將。第二是政治層面：開禧北伐全局失敗的責任並不因六合的勝利而減輕，韓侂冄於開禧三年（一二〇七）被部下殺害，宋廷隨即轉為守勢，嘉定元年（一二〇八）與金成嘉定和議，宋增歲幣、加輸犒軍銀，兩國關係又回到伯侄之稱的屈辱格局。吳曦之亂雖迅速平定，蜀地的傷害卻元氣大傷，南方政治從此更加倚重淮壩與江防，而淮壩線恰恰就是開禧與嘉定兩次大戰的戰場。第三是技術層面：弩在金宋對峙期的城防中居於核心，其壽命卻不長；其後金與蒙古軍相繼使用回回炮一類的火砲破城，十三世紀的城防最終由弩讓位給火砲，弩的時代就這樣結束了。
impactEn: The Battle of Liuhe was not large, and it changed little of the course of the war, but its consequences are worth setting down at three levels. First, the tactical level: it showed that in the absence of large siege engines, a city's defences, resting on the crossbow and on the walls themselves, could hold off cavalry several times their number, and that the crossbow's weakness of consumption could be covered for a time by deceptions of the ground such as the one used here. Thereafter the Song prefectures that defended cities laid more weight on the crossbow sections on the walls and on the moat, and Bi Zaiyu's reputation grew on the strength of this action; he was promoted through high commands and became one of the noted commanders of the late Southern Song against the Jin. Second, the political level: the responsibility for the failure of the Kaixi northern campaign was not reduced by the victory at Liuhe. Han Tuozhou was killed by his own men in the third year of Kaixi (1207), the court turned at once to the defensive, and in the first year of Jiading (1208) the Song concluded the Jiading peace with the Jin, adding to the annual tribute and paying a large sum in earnest-money for the army; the relation between the two states fell back into the humiliation of the uncle-and-nephew formula. The revolt of Wu Xi was put down quickly, but Sichuan was badly weakened by it, and southern politics came to lean all the more on the Huai dikes and the river defences, the very line on which the campaigns of Kaixi and Jiading were fought. Third, the technical level: the crossbow held the core of the city defences in the Jin-Song confrontation, but its life was not a long one. Afterwards the Jin and then the Mongol armies used bombs and other gunpowder artillery to break cities, and in the thirteenth century the crossbow gave way at last to the cannon, and with that the age of the crossbow came to an end.
result: 十一月的六合之戰以南宋收城守勝而結束。竹鎮前哨戰中宋軍弓弩齊發、伏兵突出，金軍大敗；完顏蒲剌都十萬騎兵雖圍城數重，焚木柵、決圩水皆被勁弩射退；兩軍合兵後攻城更急，畢再遇憑城死守、屢出奇兵擾敵，金軍不得休息，弓弩覆蓋下攻城將士死傷狼藉，最後引兵而去。畢再遇乘勝追擊，直抵滁州，遇雨雪方收兵回師，繳獲甚豐。至此，金軍突破淮防、打到六合的攻勢被挫折，九路南侵的鋒芒為之一挫。但六合的勝利沒有改變開禧北伐的全局：金軍其後仍佔兩淮沿線數處要地，宋廷內部追討敗責、誅除韓黨失誤，宋金戰局拖到嘉定之世才以和議收場。這一役在軍事史上的位置不在規模，而在於提供了一次以孤軍當敵眾、以弩與城為骨的守城戰樣本：它把弩的優點與弱點——精準、破甲、單發、可伏城垛，卻怕耗箭、怕攻城器械——同時寫在史頁上。
resultEn: The Battle of Liuhe in the eleventh month ended with the Southern Song still holding the city. In the action at Zhuzhen the Song crossbows fired in unison and the ambush struck out, and the Jin were routed; the one hundred thousand cavalry under Wanyan Puladu closed the city in several rings, but fire against the wooden fence and water against the embankments were both driven back by the heavy crossbows; after the two forces joined the assault tightened, Bi Zaiyu held behind the wall and sent out irregular troops again and again to harry the enemy and deny it rest, the men storming the wall under the covering fire of the crossbows were cut to pieces, and the Jin finally drew their troops off. Bi Zaiyu pursued them, reached Chuzhou, and only broke off and returned when rain and snow came on, with a rich harvest of booty. The Jin offensive that had broken through the Huai defences and reached Liuhe was blunted, and the edge of the nine-column invasion was dulled. But the victory at Liuhe did not change the shape of the Kaixi northern campaign. The Jin still held several important points along the two Huai, the Song court assigned the blame for the defeat and punished those of Han Tuozhou's party, and the war between the two states dragged on until the age of Jiading, when it was closed by a peace. The place of this action in military history lies not in its scale but in the sample it provides of a city defended by a few men against a numerous enemy, with the crossbow and the walls for its bones: it wrote down the advantages and the weakness of the crossbow at once, its precision, its power, its single shots and the way it could be worked from behind a parapet, against its appetite for arrows and its helplessness before siege engines.
